verdict.rationale: Granola Chat can query across all meetings using notes or transcripts, and the official MCP server lets connected AI tools search transcripts. The magnifying glass traces an AI-enhanced note back to its spot in the transcript or raw notes, which is a partial form of jumping to a moment. That trace starts from a generated note, though, not from a search result, and nothing shows timestamped playback. Missing for 10: a documented first-party keyword/full-text search UI across transcripts, summaries and notes; jumping from a search hit to the exact timestamped moment or audio; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.
Use the magnifying glass beside each note to see where in the transcript or raw notes the note came from
